name: nacre
description: Nacre — Dental Practice OS (React + Node/Express + MySQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && cd server && npm run db:reset
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
